framework: Antibiotic choice in sepsis must be source-directed wherever possible — broad empiric therapy without an identified source should be reassessed urgently within 24-48 hours.
Obtain blood cultures (and other relevant cultures) before antibiotics whenever this does not meaningfully delay treatment (target within 45 minutes).
De-escalate aggressively once source and organism are identified — sepsis is the syndrome that most often leads to inappropriately prolonged broad-spectrum therapy if not actively reviewed daily.
